name: Ikenie: Michiru Tsuki no Sangeki
original_name: 生贄 満ちる月の惨劇
source: The protagonist is turned into a monster by a demon. The demon tells him that before the night passes, he must hunt humans and sacrifice their souls in order to gain the rights to reincarnate in the next life. The prey are 15 female students and several male staff who are hiding inside the school.
